description: Tekken 3 (Namco, 1998), recompiled for the TrimUI Brick.
features: Resolution: the game's own, or twice it on the Brick's 1024x768 screen, set in Options.
Shadows: the fighters cast their shadows on the floor along the stage's sun.
Lighting: the fighters shade themselves and each other pixel by pixel.
Spark Lighting: every hit spark lights the fighters and the floor, set in Options.
Stage moods and flavour: torches, storms, mist, snow, embers and more.
Fight GUI and Unlock Everything, set in Options.
Controls: every button can be remapped, set in Options.
